decisions.reason: A classic lever handle line close to the core range is cheap to keep in the catalogue, though its absence from the website in 2020–2021 and the firm's 2019 pruning raise some withdrawal risk.
A multi-model handle family supports the firm's system breadth across budget levels, but its absence from the website suggests possible consolidation.
A single design is the most exposed to pruning, as the similar Product C showed, but it still costs little to maintain in project business.
A handle family with several models fits the design-breadth strategy, though range consolidation remains a moderate risk.
